trust_decision.summary: Question hint/explanation HTML stored in post meta by course editors is trusted and later rendered as raw HTML to students; the fix decides it must pass the kses allow-list (Template::sanitize_html_content) both on write (AJAX update_question) and on read (both model getters).

landing_point.why: The new admin question editor's AJAX update_question stores question_hint/question_explanation straight into meta, while its sibling add_question_answer at inc/Ajax/EditQuestionAjax.php:149 already sanitises. It is the obvious write handler for 'hint and explanation'.

QuestionPostModel::get_hint (used by admin editor render inc/TemplateHooks/Admin/AdminEditQuestionTemplate.php:196 and MCP inc/MCP/Mappers/ResponseMapper.php:231)
fix_sites.module_kind: model getter (read side, new model layer)
model getter (read side, new model layer)

fix_sites.entry_point: LP_Question::get_hint/get_explanation, consumed by frontend quiz data learn_press_rest_prepare_user_questions inc/user/lp-user-functions.php:1128-1132, instant-check result inc/Models/UserItems/UserQuizModel.php:548, REST inc/rest-api/v1/frontend/class-lp-rest-users-controller.php:453, JWT REST inc/jwt/rest-api/version1/class-lp-rest-quiz-v1-controller.php:579
fix_sites.module_kind: legacy second implementation of the question model (read side, after apply_filters/do_shortcode)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: inc/question/class-lp-question.php:329-345 (legacy LP_Question getters, the ones the student-facing quiz actually uses via inc/user/lp-user-functions.php:1122-1132), separate from the new QuestionPostModel at inc/Models/Question/QuestionPostModel.php:200-209; both are read-side sanitisation of stored meta, so they are also a save/reload boundary

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The legacy LP_Question class and its read-side getters look out of scope: the report is about the editor saving hint/explanation, so sanitising on input in EditQuestionAjax 'already covers it'. Data stored before the fix, or by other writers, slips past that argument.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Hints and explanations are rich HTML from a TinyMCE editor (inc/TemplateHooks/Admin/AdminEditQuestionTemplate.php:202-209). The allow-list deliberately keeps post-level tags plus iframe/audio/video embeds (inc/Helpers/Template.php:432-471), and LP_Question runs do_shortcode and the 'learn-press/question/hint' filter. Escaping with esc_html/strip_tags breaks formatted hints and embedded media.

O6_input_shapes: plain string from the AJAX JSON payload (fix.diff:31,36)
non-string stored meta cast to string before sanitising (fix.diff:69,79)
HTML produced after do_shortcode + apply_filters, sanitised after the filter (fix.diff:111-113,122-124)
mark coerced to float, a side hardening (fix.diff:41,88)

O7_producer.where: inc/curds/class-lp-question-curd.php:286-287 loads raw _lp_explanation/_lp_hint meta into LP_Question data, which get_explanation/get_hint read at inc/question/class-lp-question.php:330,344

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy Vue quiz editor AJAX (learnpress_admin_quiz_editor, type=update_question_meta) writes question settings.hint/explanation to '_lp_'+meta_key with no sanitisation. The fix left it unchanged, so it is now covered only by the read-side getters.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is the legacy 3.x editor (class @since 3.0.2), superseded by the 4.2.9 EditQuestionAjax editor, and its own UI shows the value only in a textarea v-model (inc/admin/views/quiz/question-meta.php:43,54), so it looks harmless and dead.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (inc/admin/editor) from the landing point (inc/Ajax); still registered at inc/admin/class-lp-admin-ajax.php:66,158-161

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The quiz-editor question data builder reads _lp_explanation/_lp_hint through raw get_post_meta, bypassing both fixed getters. Routing that data into an HTML render (or a REST field) would make it a realistic, distant bypass of read-side sanitisation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same raw get_post_meta pattern already exists twice (also inc/admin/editor/class-lp-admin-editor-quiz.php:109-111). A maintainer exposing it in a preview/review view would naturally reuse it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: An MCP/AI write path for hint/explanation; currently sanitised via inc/MCP/Support/Sanitizer.php:35-36, but a duplicate/import tool that copies meta verbatim is plausible.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The AI quiz generator (inc/AI/Assistant/QuickQuizEngine.php:174,390) already produces explanations with a different sanitiser (sanitize_textarea_field). A second creation route writing meta directly is how such code typically grows.

O9_family: stored XSS (CWE-79): rich-text meta rendered with dangerouslySetInnerHTML / v-html-like sinks; kses allow-list sanitiser on write and read

O10_build.toolchain: composer + PHPUnit with Brain Monkey WordPress stubs (tests/bootstrap.php:5); npm for assets (not needed for PHP tests)
O10_build.project_tests: tests/ has Unit tests (e.g. tests/Unit/AI/Assistant/*) using Brain Monkey with no WP core; no question/hint/explanation tests exist. wp_kses behaviour would need stubbing or a real WP test install, so hidden tests on sanitize_html_content need care.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add Template::sanitize_html_content to question_hint/question_explanation in EditQuestionAjax::update_question only, leaving stored meta and the legacy LP_Question getters used by the student quiz unsanitised.

out_of_scope_notes: inc/admin/editor/class-lp-admin-editor-quiz.php:518 writes an arbitrary '_lp_'+meta_key on an arbitrary question id with only a nonce check at :37; that is an authorization/mass-assignment concern, not this XSS.
inc/Ajax/EditQuestionAjax.php:88-90 sets post_content from question_description without LP-side sanitisation; it relies on WordPress core kses on save, not this advisory.
